newsitem.title: USA: American Classic Q4 net soars after gain.
newsitem.headline: American Classic Q4 net soars after gain.

text.p: American Classic Voyages Co said Tuesday gains from a hotel sale and a tax adjustment sent fourth-quarter earnings soaring compared to year-ago results.

The company reported net income of $22.4 million, or $1.62 a share, in the period ended December 31, versus $197,000, or $0.01 a share, one year ago. The latest results included an $11.7-million or $0.57-a-share gain from the sale of the Maison Dupuy Hotel and an $8,028 tax adjustment gain, American Classic Voyages said.
Without the gain and adjustment, fourth-quarter net income totaled $2.1 million, or $0.15 a share, the company said.
Revenues were $50.2 million, versus $47.9 million in 1995.
American Classic Voyages owns and operates two cruise lines, American Hawaii Cruises and Delta Steamboat Co.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 Tuesday at 13.
